+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def extract_json(text: str, schema_hint: str | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    prompt = "Extract the requested structured JSON from the text. Return only valid JSON."
+    if schema_hint:
+        prompt = f"{prompt} Schema hint: {schema_hint}"
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "You extract structured data and output only JSON.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": f"{prompt}\n\nText:\n{text}",
+            },
+        ],
+        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
+    )
+    output_text = response.output_text
+    return json.loads(output_text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    source_text = sys.stdin.read()
+    result = extract_json(source_text)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
*** End Patch

+import os
+import sys
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def summarize_text(text: str, max_output_tokens: int = 200) -> str:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Summarize the user's text concisely and accurately.",
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": text},
+        ],
+        max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens,
+    )
+    return response.output_text
+
+
+def _read_text_from_args() -> str:
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
+        return " ".join(sys.argv[1:])
+    return sys.stdin.read()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    text = _read_text_from_args().strip()
+    if not text:
+        raise SystemExit("No input text provided")
+    print(summarize_text(text))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
